## PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Video producer with 11+ years of experience leading documentary and branded shoots from pitch to delivery. Known for calm sets, tidy budgets and crews that want to come back.

## EXPERIENCE

### Producer
Tidewater Signal Studios | Port Calloway, CA | March 2023 – January 2026
- Produced 40 episodes of a harbor documentary series on a fixed budget.
- Trained 12 volunteer camera operators and built their on-set skills in two weekends.
- Launched an educational video series for the maritime museum that ran for three seasons.
- Wrote the weekly production summary that replaced a 90-minute status meeting.
- Cut vendor costs 18% by rebidding the lighting and grip packages.

### Producer
Lanternfish Media Collective | Remote | June 2020 – February 2023
- Ran a 9-person remote post team across four time zones.
- Delivered 25 branded shorts with an average turnaround of six days.
- Built the education and skills onboarding kit every new editor used.

### Associate Producer
Copperline Broadcast Group | Elk Hollow, OR | August 2017 – May 2020
- Scheduled 120 studio days a year for two live shows.
- Managed releases, call sheets and travel for crews of up to 30.
- Coordinated summary reports for the experience design team after every broadcast.
- Tracked a $250K seasonal budget to within 2%.

### Production Coordinator
Quillfeather Community Films (Volunteer Crew Program) | Elk Hollow, OR | January 2015 – July 2017
- Booked locations, permits and catering for 14 short films.
- Kept the volunteer roster and the skills matrix current for 60 crew members.

- Production: budgeting, scheduling, call sheets, vendor management.
